Label 寺 at y1018-1080; value 百(1437-1498) 十(1521-1581) 七(1605-1665) ヶ(1696-1735) 寺(1773-1834). The 十 is a plain cross (not 千) and the order is 百-十-七, so 117, not 170.

Editorial note from the 1928 movable-type reprint: 'the following two lines stood in red ink in the margin [of the manuscript].' Not data. A complete paren pair of its own, ︵(y1014-1038) 以 下 二 行 欄 外 朱 書 ︶(y1450-1471), ink x1861-1924. The 'two lines' it refers to are the next two columns to its left — （兵隊十二小隊〔一隊三十人〕 and 合三百六十人）— which are wrapped by a SECOND paren pair that opens atop the 兵隊 column and closes below 合三百六十人, spanning both. The box's left edge is set at the measured ink minimum x1864; only the anti-aliased tip of the 兵隊 column's opening paren falls outside.

Domain-boundary marker ○三日月藩 (Mikazuki, a 15,000-koku Mori-house domain in Harima). The only marker on the leaf. Ink x1505-1595: ○(y1352-1429) 三(1464-1534) 日(1592-1666) 月(1722-1804) 藩(1855-1937). It is the pivot for the whole page: everything to its RIGHT (x1650-2678) is the PREVIOUS domain, Mibu (壬生藩), whose block ends here; everything to its LEFT (x957-1470) is Mikazuki's, whose block starts here and continues on the facing 75R.

Assessed yield (kokudaka): 15,000 koku. Mikazuki's official omotedaka, the first column left of its ○ marker. In addition: 560.487 koku of newly opened land (新開地) — a supplement to the 15,000-koku main assessment. The small 外ニ prefix is printed as a right-side gloss (x1328-1374, y1165-1269) beside the main run (x1235-1319): 高(y1177-1241), 五(1353-1405) 百(1433-1493) 六(1516-1575) 十(1601-1661) 石(1685-1745) 四(1771-1825) 斗(1851-1912) 八(1939-1994) 升(2023-2082) 七(2106-2166) 合(2189-2250), then 新(2360-2420) 開(2443-2502) 地(2530-2587). Sub-units run strictly descending 石 > 斗(.1) > 升(.01) > 合(.001) ✓ = 560 + 0.4 + 0.08 + 0.007. The box encloses the offset 外ニ prefix together with its value, which is why it is wider than a normal column.

Main land tax (正租), soybean component: 1,397.8906 koku. The column carries no label of its own — 正租 heads the 米 column to its right and governs both. Value: 大(1344-1403) 豆(1431-1486) 千(1515-1570) 三(1600-1652) 百(1681-1742) 九(1766-1827) 十(1848-1907) 七(1931-1992) 石(2017-2075) 八(2099-2153) 斗(2180-2241) 九(2268-2326) 升(2356-2415) 六(2438-2497) 勺(2523-2586). The 合 place is SKIPPED (= 0), so 1397 + 0.8 + 0.09 + 0.0006. MASTER's raw string matches but its parse (1397.89006) puts the 6 in the 才 place: the final glyph is 勺, identical in shape to and at the same y as the 五勺 of the 正租米 column (y2522-2584), and 正租米 then has one MORE glyph (四才, y2691-2749) that this column does not. So 六勺 = 0.0006 and the value is 1,397.8906.
